title: Graph Solution Sets of Linear Systems of Inequalities

children: Graph the solution set of a system of linear inequalities in one or two variables.

In general, to solve systems of linear inequalities, we will take the following steps.
Graph each inequality in the system on the same coordinate axes using solid or dashed lines as appropriate.
Find the region where the graphs overlap.
Select a test point from the region to verify the solution.
Graph only the solution set, if there is one.
